easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as HYDRA Assault Robot is a Pirate due to Leyline of Transformation, creating a Treasure token
When the Treasure enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.
